verdict.rationale: stagewise's agent can edit files across workspaces, run shell commands, and orchestrate multi-step workflows. A GitHub plugin gives it access to issues and pull requests, and diff review lets the developer vet the changes. Together these supply the building blocks for an issue-to-PR flow, but no documented end-to-end workflow ties them together. Missing for 10: a documented issue-to-PR workflow (picking up an issue, branching, committing, and opening the PR automatically), detail on what the GitHub plugin can actually do with issues and PRs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the flow working.
